purpose: Six original heraldic textures for UV mapping onto authored flags; image colors remapped to matte cloth ink inside Blender, originals unchanged.

entries.motif: an upright slender sword integrated into a precise eight-point compass rose, a single pair of swept falcon wings flaring to both sides, three stepped feather groups per wing, narrow central blade and beautifully spaced directional points; restrained orderly expedition command crest. Elegant symmetry, readable winged blade as the main silhouette.
entries.prompt: Create ONE exquisite game faction heraldic insignia DECAL, square image, genuinely transparent background, no background surface. Flat orthographic straight-on graphic artwork intended as a texture printed/embroidered onto a dark fantasy military cloth banner in a Civilization-like strategy map. Only the compact emblem is visible, centered at 72% canvas width and 75% height. Sharp elegant silhouette, commanding identifiable primary motif with very restrained secondary detail, strong negative-space cuts that stay recognizable at 32px. Engraved medieval heraldic illustration in only warm ivory and muted antique brass ochre; dark areas and holes TRANSPARENT, not filled black. Flat albedo colors with subtle fine thread/engraving strokes and sparse worn ink gaps. No raised 3D relief, no cast shadow, no beveled shiny medal, no frame or shield-shaped background, no letters, no text, no flag/pole, no gradient backdrop, no fake checkerboard. This is one unified emblem, not a sheet. Main symbol: an upright slender sword integrated into a precise eight-point compass rose, a single pair of swept falcon wings flaring to both sides, three stepped feather groups per wing, narrow central blade and beautifully spaced directional points; restrained orderly expedition command crest. Elegant symmetry, readable winged blade as the main silhouette.

entries.motif: a fierce desert wolf head in frontal three-quarter heraldic pose, tall pointed ears, angular cheek ruff, strong tapered muzzle, dark cutout eyes, ivory fur planes with antique-ochre cheek detailing; two restrained curved sand strokes cradle the lower jaw. Wolf head overwhelmingly dominates, no full animal body.
